Let ∠ADB= θ.
∠ADB = ∠CAD [AC = CD]
∠ACB = ∠CAD + ∠ADC =2θ Exterior angle
∠ABC = ∠ACB [AB = AC]
∠ABD = ∠DAB [AD = BD]
∴In △ABC
θ + 2θ + 2θ = 180 ̊
θ = 36 ̊
∴∠ADB = 36 ̊

options_en: 5/2

13/5

options_hi: 5/2
12/5
13/5
5/13
questions.solution_en:
Using Identity
Sec² A - tan² A = 1
(SecA + tanA)(SecA - tanA) = 1
SecA - tanA = 1/5….(i) (∵SecA + tanA = 5, given)
SecA + tanA = 5….(ii)
Adding equations (i) and (ii)
2SecA = 5 + 1/5
SecA = 26/10 = 13/5
questions.solution_hi:
पहचान का उपयोग करना

Sec² A - tan² A = 1

(SecA + tanA)(SecA - tanA) = 1

SecA - tanA = 1/5...(i) (∵SecA + tanA = 5, दिया गया)

SecA + tanA = 5...(ii)

समीकरण (i) और (ii) जोड़ने पर

2SecA = 5 + 1/5
SecA = 26/10 = 13/5
